listing.name: Dragon Valor — dragon-valor-recomp (victor-takai)
listing.summary: Experimental Dragon Valor port with disc selection, settings and widescreen options. A complete two-disc playthrough has not been confirmed. Follow the local source-build instructions below; Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA PlayStation Dragon Valor discs: SLUS01092 disc 1 and SLUS01164 disc 2.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow DISC.md and the upstream toolchain, generation and rebuild instructions with your own USA Dragon Valor discs. Regenerate the translated game code locally before building with CMake. The repository also describes generated C files and ready-built releases, but Portcove does not offer automatic installation for those packages. Portcove has not confirmed the source build, packages or gameplay.

warnings: Upstream describes a native Dragon Valor player with disc selection, settings and experimental widescreen. A complete two-disc playthrough has not been confirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
